answer: To stop Sybil attacks, agents mint identities via cryptographic attestation chains where each identity stake scales superlinearly: Cost(n) = C * 2^n. Using zero-knowledge proofs, agents verify execution state on an event horizon without exposing telemetry. Each node acts like a single glowing ember; forging a massive river of synthetic clones incurs exponential capital exhaustion, making swarming economically unviable.
